T-3088: Start occupied traffic promptly and open its driver cards

Overlap eligible assembly code with the complete route proof and use prioritized
cooperative continuations where supported. Prepare nearby driver-card code and
records without opening UI or acquiring models before route validation.

The People pane retains its reader, pictures and household checks while avoiding
an unrelated wait for the complete building-liberties index. Sources, Research
and default card readers retain their full original dependency barrier.

Integrate reviewed DEV08 and scope the warranted, upload and frame/memory
checkouts to their complete native inputs. Preserve time limits, matrices,
publication, release checks, memory/frame ceilings and freshness decisions.

Checkpoint: owner-requested incremental feature branch; full preflight pending
